author: Russell Brand
description:
Before the pandemic. Before the mandates. Before the world had ever heard of Moderna. Rishi Sunak's investment fund was already in — when the company had just 10 employees. Russell Brand breaks down the timeline and it does not add up. Sunak invested early, then as Chancellor signed deals for millions of Moderna doses, then as Prime Minister locked Britain into a ten-year vaccine manufacturing partnership with the same company. At what point does coincidence become conflict of interest and at what point does conflict of interest become something far darker. You decide.
